module: Module 1: How Pay Works at Brunswick
title: Interaction: What Factors Explain This?

Statement_01.text: Each card describes a real-world pay situation. Select each one to reveal which factors explain it.

narration.text: Let's put those factors to work. Each card describes a real-world pay situation. Select each one to reveal which factors explain it.

visual_notes: Four click-to-reveal scenario cards. Continue gated until all four visited.

cards.label: Two analysts hold the same job title, but one is paid more.
cards.reveal_text: One holds a specialized certification and has several more years of sustained strong performance in the role.

cards.label: The same grade carries different ranges in two different cities.
cards.reveal_text: Ranges reflect the cost of labor in each market.

cards.label: A recently promoted employee is near the minimum of their new range.
cards.reveal_text: They're new to the grade and building skills — exactly where the range design expects them to start.

cards.label: A long-tenured employee is near the maximum of their range.
cards.reveal_text: Years of sustained high performance and deep expertise move people toward the top of a range over time.
